name: Rage
tagline: Low-poly worlds, built to be explored.
intro: 3D generalist making environments, props and characters for games and animation. Rotate the mesh, then browse the work.
about: I'm a self-taught 3D generalist based in Tamil Nadu, India. I build stylised, low-poly assets that stay light on performance and heavy on mood.
I like to take a piece from blockout to engine-ready, so I handle modelling, UVs, texturing and setup myself.
